title: Wall Pass
description: A simple one-touch pass against a wall to improve passing accuracy and first touch.
instructions: Stand 2-3 meters from a wall. Pass the ball against the wall using the inside of your foot, control the rebound, and repeat. Alternate feet.

title: Cone Dribbling
description: Dribble through a line of cones using both feet to improve close control.
instructions: Place cones in a straight line 1 meter apart. Dribble through the cones using quick touches, alternating feet. Return to start and repeat.

title: Shuttle Runs
description: Sprint between two points to improve acceleration and anaerobic fitness.
instructions: Place two cones 20 meters apart. Sprint from one cone to the other, touch the ground, and sprint back. Repeat for desired repetitions.

title: Heading Practice
description: Throw the ball against a wall and head it back to improve heading accuracy and timing.
instructions: Stand 2 meters from a wall. Throw the ball against the wall and attempt to head it back at a specific point on the wall. Repeat.
